title: NASA FIRMS Active Fire Detections (MODIS C6.1 and VIIRS 375 m)
description: Point locations of satellite-detected active fires and thermal anomalies from MODIS Collection 6.1 (1 km, Terra and Aqua) and VIIRS 375 m (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21), distributed by NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) in near real time and as a standard-quality archive.
purpose: Monitoring and historical analysis of wildfires in Algeria's northern forests and maquis, crop-residue and stubble burning, and gas flaring / industrial heat sources in the Sahara.

spatial_extent.description: Global. FIRMS offers yearly per-country CSV summaries, including Algeria (verified for MODIS and VIIRS S-NPP 2023); otherwise subset by bounding box (API) or by drawing an area in the archive download tool.

temporal_extent.frequency: multiple overpasses per day (near real time); archive updated with standard-quality data
temporal_extent.description: Archive coverage stated on the FIRMS download page (2026-11-19): MODIS C6.1 from 1 Nov 2000 - present; VIIRS S-NPP 375 m 20 Jan 2012 - 2 Nov 2026; VIIRS NOAA-20 375 m 1 Apr 2018 - present; VIIRS NOAA-21 375 m 1 Mar 2023 - present. NRT data are replaced by standard science-quality data with approximately a 5-month lag.

resolution.spatial: 375 m (VIIRS I-band) and 1 km (MODIS) nominal pixel size; delivered as pixel-centre points

crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS 84) latitude/longitude of fire pixel centres

variables.name: brightness / bright_ti4
variables.description: Brightness temperature of the fire pixel (MODIS: brightness; VIIRS: I-4 band)

variables.name: daynight, type
variables.description: Day/night flag; inferred hot-spot type code (see FIRMS FAQ for code meanings)

processing: Active fire pixels are detected in MODIS (MCD14) and VIIRS I-band (VNP14IMG/VJ114IMG/VJ214IMG) swath data using contextual thermal-anomaly algorithms (Giglio et al. 2016; Schroeder et al. 2014). LANCE produces near-real-time detections (global within about 3 hours of observation); standard-processing (SP) science-quality detections later replace NRT data in the FIRMS archive.
limitations: Detections are thermal anomalies, not burned area; a single fire can produce many points and small or short-lived fires between overpasses or under cloud/smoke may be missed.
Static industrial heat sources (e.g. gas flares at Saharan oil and gas fields) are detected and must be filtered using the 'type' attribute or a flare mask before wildfire analysis.
Point location is the pixel centre; actual fire can be anywhere within the 375 m or 1 km footprint (larger off-nadir).
Sensor continuity: FIRMS lists VIIRS S-NPP coverage ending 2 Nov 2026, and NASA states Terra observations are scheduled to cease on 1 Dec 2026; long time series must account for sensor changes.
API and NRT services require a free MAP_KEY (limit 5000 transactions per 10-minute interval); archive download requires Earthdata Login or email code.
version: MODIS Collection 6.1 (MCD14DL, 6.1NRT); VIIRS 375 m Version 2 (VNP14IMGTDL_NRT, VJ114IMGTDL_NRT, VJ214IMGTDL_NRT)

FIRMS API (area endpoint, MAP_KEY required)
access.notes: Free MAP_KEY by email; /api/area/csv/[MAP_KEY]/[SOURCE]/[west,south,east,north]/[DAY_RANGE 1-5]/[DATE]; sources include MODIS_NRT, MODIS_SP, VIIRS_SNPP_NRT/SP, VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT/SP, VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT/SP. The 'country' endpoint was flagged 'Feature currently not available' on 2026-11-19.

algeria_notes: Algeria's summer wildfires in the Tell Atlas (e.g. Kabylie, El Tarf) are captured, but Saharan gas flares form persistent hot-spot clusters that must be excluded. VIIRS 375 m is preferred for small agricultural fires; MODIS gives the longer record (from Nov 2000).

verification.notes: Collection DOIs taken from NASA CMR (provider LANCEMODIS) and all four resolve (HTTP 200). The 'doi' field holds the MODIS C6.1 NRT DOI; VIIRS DOIs are in 'citation'. The exact FIRMS-recommended per-product citation wording could not be copied verbatim (page quote limits), so 'citation' is assembled from CMR product names and DOIs. Data_type 'point'. Variable names checked against the headers of the Algeria 2023 country CSVs (MODIS: brightness, bright_t31, frp, confidence, daynight, type; VIIRS: bright_ti4, bright_ti5, frp, confidence, daynight, type). The meaning of 'type' codes is from general FIRMS documentation and was not re-read on 2026-11-19.
